name: Zulma Tovar-Spinoza
identity: Professor of Neurosurgery, Neurology & Pediatrics and longtime pediatric epilepsy/LITT lead at SUNY Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital, Syracuse NY (recently affiliated with Driscoll Children's Hospital, Corpus Christi TX).
bio: Tovar-Spinoza is one of the most-published pediatric LITT surgeons in the world and a foundational KOL in MR-guided laser interstitial thermal therapy for children with drug-resistant epilepsy and brain tumors. She built the SUNY Upstate pediatric MRgLITT program starting in 2013, pioneering staged ablation of cortical tubers and robot-assisted LITT of hypothalamic hamartomas. She discloses a consultant relationship with Monteris Medical (NeuroBlate) and has authored key editorials and technique papers spanning both the NeuroBlate and Visualase platforms.
training: Universidad de Los Andes School of Medicine (MD, 1993) · Neurosurgery residency (institution not verified) · Pediatric Neurosurgery & Pediatric Epilepsy Fellowship, The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), Toronto, 2006-2008 · pedigree note: SickKids pediatric epilepsy surgery lineage; internationally recognized pediatric MRgLITT pioneer.
litt_exposure: Extensive, high-volume direct operator experience since 2013; disclosed Monteris/NeuroBlate consultant. Published pediatric LITT series across brain tumors, cortical tubers, cavernous malformations and hypothalamic hamartomas. Note: her earliest tumor series used Visualase (Medtronic); the SUNY Upstate program has used both platforms, so she is genuinely dual-platform but carries an explicit NeuroBlate consulting relationship.
wheelhouse: Pediatric epilepsy surgery, MRgLITT (tumors, cortical tubers, hypothalamic hamartoma, cavernous malformations), stereotactic/functional and pediatric neuro-oncology.
kol_note: Tier-1 pediatric LITT KOL: prolific author, guest editor of a Frontiers in Neurology MRg-LiTT editorial (2024), disclosed Monteris/NeuroBlate consultant. Reference-account caliber advocate for the platform in pediatrics.
